feedback: The confession follows the chemistry and the false service account already available before voting. Brie's explanation of moving flavoring into the pitcher precisely matches the contradiction that singled her out, so the finale confirms a deduction rather than rescuing an unsolvable puzzle. Opening the bottle during the closed preview specifies a moment that was previously only an available opportunity; it is helpful mechanism detail, not a new decisive identification fact. Her staff's trust gives the admission more emotional force than the supplier debt alone, while Barb's advice to let them leave nicely carries their relationship forward. Chip's surrender of the workbench keys also develops his controlling habit into an earned consequence. The finale is concise and satisfying.
